written.headline: Researchers publish AI-aided Navier-Stokes blowup proof
written.summary: NYU professor Tristan Buckmaster and Anthropic employee Levent Alpöge published an AI-aided proof of Navier-Stokes blowup. The researchers stated that their work closes a loophole present in OpenAI's September solution.

written.headline: SoftBank explored a $1 trillion buyout of SK Hynix
written.summary: SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son explored financing for a potential $1 trillion buyout of memory chip giant SK Hynix. SoftBank stated that the deal is no longer under active consideration.

written.headline: Cognition AI in funding talks at a $75 billion valuation
written.summary: Cognition AI Inc. is in funding talks to raise $2 billion or more at a $75 billion valuation. The startup has raised over $3 billion in 2026 so far, including $2 billion at a $48 billion valuation in September.

written.headline: Oracle says OpenAI infrastructure contract is fully funded
written.summary: Oracle announced that its infrastructure contract with OpenAI is fully funded following a final capital raise earlier this month. The company stated it is the first hyperscaler fully funded for this investment cycle.

written.headline: Nvidia faces U.S. SEC accounting investigation, sources say
written.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating Nvidia's accounting practices, according to two people briefed on the matter. The probe adds to regulatory and legal challenges for the chipmaker, whose shares dropped about 13% on Friday.
